runner_contract.barrier_assertion: No scored future may issue network I/O before every scored worker is armed; coordinator releases one barrier and observed maximum simultaneous in-flight must equal the labeled concurrency.
runner_contract.failure_policy: Construction does not assert 12.7% realized. Missing counters, query-delta mismatch, returned-token mismatch, output truncation, barrier failure, or hit delta above the construction bound invalidates the arm.
raw_evidence: canonical submitted request bytes and SHA-256
raw streaming response chunks and SHA-256
returned prompt token IDs equal submitted prompt list
complete output token IDs count 358 for scored requests
server usage prompt_tokens equals 4214 (or 10000 for separate stream)
before_warmup, after_warmup, after_scored raw Prometheus snapshots per primary group
monotonic submit/start/first-token/end timestamps and maximum simultaneous in flight
runner_contract.warmup_exclusion: Warmups request one output token and are setup only. Cache fraction, throughput, output, and latency aggregates use scored requests and after_warmup-to-after_scored counter deltas only.

separate_10k_stream.cache_assertion: pairwise LCP with every primary request is zero; require query delta 10000 and hit delta zero
separate_10k_stream.ordering: run after the primary groups with its own before/after metrics snapshots

target.interpretation: 535 common tokens is the nearest integer construction to 12.7%; exact-image APC can credit at most 528 full-block tokens. Only scored vllm:prefix_cache_hits deltas establish realization.
